## 31.1 Genie.jl: Julia's Web Framework

Genie.jl is a full-stack web framework for Julia that enables deploying spatial analysis results as HTTP APIs or interactive web applications. For healthcare organizations, a Genie.jl service can expose rural access scores, LISA cluster maps, and provider shortage designations through a REST API that electronic health record systems, state health department dashboards, and grant reporting tools can query programmatically. This chapter builds a complete REST API service exposing the North Dakota healthcare access analysis.

```julia
# === web/app.jl: Genie.jl REST API for Healthcare GIS ===
# Install: ] add Genie
# Run: julia web/app.jl
using Genie, Genie.Router, Genie.Renderer.Json
using DataFrames, JSON3
using SpatialStats
# ── Pre-load analysis results at startup ─────────────────────
const ND_DATA = Ref{NamedTuple}()
function __init_analysis__()
@info "Loading ND analysis data..."
nd_df = CSV.read("data/processed/nd_analysis_results.csv", DataFrame)
w     = deserialize("data/processed/nd_weights.jls")  # serialized weights
```

ND_DATA[] = (; nd_df, w)

```julia
@info "Analysis data loaded: $(nrow(nd_df)) counties"
end
# ── API Routes ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# GET /api/counties — list all county summaries
route("/api/counties") do
df = ND_DATA[].nd_df
result = [(
geoid        = r.GEOID,
name         = r.NAME,
access_score = r.access_score,
lisa_cluster = string(r.lisa_cluster),
poverty_pct  = r.poverty_pct,
uninsured_pct= r.uninsured_pct
) for r in eachrow(df)]
json(result)
end
# GET /api/county/{geoid} — single county details
route("/api/county/:geoid") do
geoid = params(:geoid)
df    = ND_DATA[].nd_df
row   = findfirst(==(geoid), df.GEOID)
isnothing(row) && return json(Dict("error" => "County $(geoid) not found"); status=404)
r = df[row, :]
json((
geoid          = r.GEOID,
name           = r.NAME,
access_score   = r.access_score,
lisa_cluster   = string(r.lisa_cluster),
poverty_pct    = r.poverty_pct,
neighbors      = neighbors(ND_DATA[].w, row)
))
end
# POST /api/moran — compute Moran's I for custom variable
route("/api/moran", method=POST) do
body  = Genie.Requests.jsonpayload()
vals  = Float64.(body["values"])
w     = ND_DATA[].w
length(vals) == nobs(w) ||
return json(Dict("error" => "Expected $(nobs(w)) values"); status=400)
result = moran(vals, w)
json((
```

I        = result.I,

expected = result.expected_I,

z_score  = result.z_score,

p_value  = result.p_value,

method   = string(result.method)

))

```julia
end
# GET /api/access?catchment=45 — recompute access with custom catchment
route("/api/access") do
catchment_km = parse(Float64, get(params(), :catchment, "45"))
(1.0 <= catchment_km <= 200.0) ||
return json(Dict("error" => "catchment must be 1-200 km"); status=400)
prov = CSV.read("data/processed/providers_geocoded.csv", DataFrame)
df   = ND_DATA[].nd_df
providers = DataFrame(lat=prov.lat, lon=prov.lon, supply=ones(nrow(prov)))
pop_locs  = DataFrame(
id=1:nrow(df), lat=df.centroid_lat,
lon=df.centroid_lon, population=coalesce.(df.total_pop, 0.0))
access = e2sfca(providers, pop_locs, catchment_km; decay=:gaussian)
json([(geoid=df.GEOID[i], access_score=access.accessibility[i]) for i in 1:nrow(df)])
end
# ── Start server ──────────────────────────────────────────────
__init_analysis__()
```

Genie.config.run_as_server = true

Genie.startup(port=8080, async=false)


## 31.2 Containerized Deployment with Docker

```julia
# === Dockerfile for HealthcareGIS web service ===
```

FROM julia:1.10-bullseye

WORKDIR /app

```julia
# Install system dependencies for GDAL, PROJ, GEOS
```

RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \

libgdal-dev libproj-dev libgeos-dev \

&& rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

```julia
# Copy project files
```

COPY Project.toml Manifest.toml ./

COPY src/ ./src/

COPY web/ ./web/

COPY data/processed/ ./data/processed/

```julia
# Pre-compile all packages (speeds up container startup)
```

RUN julia --project=. -e 'import Pkg; Pkg.instantiate()'

RUN julia --project=. -e '

```julia
using PackageCompiler
create_sysimage(
[:Genie, :SpatialStats, :GeoMakie, :DataFrames],
sysimage_path="/app/geo_sysimage.so",
precompile_execution_file="web/precompile.jl"
)'
```

EXPOSE 8080

```julia
# Start server using precompiled sysimage (fast startup)
```

CMD ["julia", "-J/app/geo_sysimage.so", "--project=.", "web/app.jl"]

```julia
# === Build and run ===
docker build -t healthcare-geo:latest .
docker run -p 8080:8080 --env CENSUS_API_KEY=$CENSUS_API_KEY healthcare-geo:latest
# Test the API
curl http://localhost:8080/api/counties | jq '.[0]'
curl 'http://localhost:8080/api/access?catchment=30' | jq 'length'
```
